actualArgs.prompt:
Create one polished landscape realistic digital character-design plate for an ORIGINAL WARM-WEATHER OUTFIT on the SAME fictional adult person shown in the two local reference images. Use those references for the person's individual face, natural warm medium-brown skin texture, dark eyes/brows, dark chin-length side-parted bob and qualitative adult proportions. Keep that same person coherent across the whole new plate.

Original outfit: a muted sage-green short-sleeve camp-collar shirt with a relaxed boxy cut, sleeves clearly above the elbows, flat open collar, simple small buttons buttoned below a modest neckline, and a clean untucked upper-hip hem. Show light matte woven fabric with small soft-crisp folds and plain hems. Pair it with sand-beige loose straight ankle-length trousers, a restrained pleat/crease and smooth matte woven drape. Leave a small ankle interval above navy canvas low-top lace-up shoes with rounded toes and a slim warm-ivory flat sole. Keep exactly this shirt/trouser/shoe design and palette on every view. All newly unseen clothing construction is an original artist choice.

Arrange three clearly separated discussion views in ONE landscape plate: left, complete FRONT clothed figure; middle, complete THREE-QUARTER clothed figure; right, a larger head-and-shoulders PORTRAIT showing the same shirt collar. Both full figures stand naturally, arms relaxed slightly away from their sides, with the complete head, hands and visible feet inside frame and generous margins above hair and below shoes. Natural far-side three-quarter overlap is fine. Keep the portrait's entire head and bob silhouette in frame; its shoulders/chest may be cropped intentionally. A calm, gently pleasant expression and unobstructed brows/eyes/jaw should make the person readable. Clear readable small view labels are welcome.

Use quiet grey studio surroundings, soft balanced light, convincing skin texture and coordinated garment/shoe material language. Make the complete outfit relaxed, capable, contemporary and approachable, with deliberate neutral clothing styling. This is an artist reference, not a measured garment, a reconstructed body, a rigged avatar or a runtime proof. Preserve the referenced person's face and hair while fully authoring the new clothing composition. Produce the single finished plate with no brand marks.
